title: Enhancing the durability of Au-coated Ti porous transport layers (PTLs) with a thin Pt top layer for PEM water electrolyzer applications
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00274E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sukhvant Singh, Aditya Singh, Muhammad Azhar Iqbal, Samaneh Shahgaldi
A bilayer coating prepared by sputtering a thin Pt film on Au-electroplated Ti PTL, prevented TiOx formation, ensure low interfacial contact resistance and long-term stability. The PEMWE cell performance of 1.716 V at 2.0 A cm−2 was achieved.
